attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the claim in his own prose.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves both categorical measurement claims without adding a forecast or condition.

contract.note: Retrospective task expenditure is a fair ordinary reading of measurable cost. The contract appropriately separates direct charges from complete business costs and realized ROI. May supplies contemporaneous counterexamples to the asserted ongoing inability.

evidence.note: The May benchmark reports task-attributable API charges from billing records. It contradicts the cost component under the contract. These are vendor-operated measurements, without independent replication; they establish neither complete business costs nor realized ROI.
The dated user report describes trace costs and a session aggregation failure. It illustrates incomplete visibility but provides no verified task expenditure or financial ROI measurement.
The May preprint projects benefits from time savings and assumed redeployment. It does not measure attributable realized financial returns.

reviews.rationale: The cost component is contradicted by documented May task-level API expenditure under the fair contract reading. The separate impossibility claim about measuring realized financial ROI remains unresolved; neither projected savings nor reporting difficulties settle it. No component is affirmatively supported.

attribution.note: Zitron presents the asserted requirements as his own conclusion.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the claim of necessity conditional on meeting projections and commitments. It does not assert that fulfillment will occur.

contract.note: The contract fairly distinguishes necessity from joint occurrence and fulfillment from announcements. The nearby four-year language supports a provisional horizon. Undefined financial measures limit eventual resolution but do not justify a present failure finding.

evidence.note: OpenAI's disclosure documents an announced multiyear AWS commitment. It establishes neither completed fulfillment nor the necessity of the asserted financial requirements.
Anthropic's disclosure distinguishes immediate investment from possible future investment. Its financing and revenue claims do not establish fulfillment or necessary financing.
OpenAI reports committed financing before the statement. This is a company disclosure, not proof of received funds, future requirements, or fulfillment of the antecedent.
The October filing is available before the cutoff and describes uncertain compute needs and continuing commitments. It is a company disclosure and supplies no qualifying early-resolution event.

reviews.rationale: The provisional June 2030 horizon has not elapsed. Fulfillment of the referenced commitments is unestablished, and no evidence meets the early-resolution rule. Financing announcements, reported growth, and compute risks cannot settle whether all three requirements are necessary.
